name: BlockEcho
mechanic: A playful lock: your trade clears only when its amount matches the current block number.
plain: Every block on the chain has a number that ticks up over time. Your trade only clears if the amount you're swapping ends in the same last digits as the current block number. A playful lock tied to the chain's own clock - retry on the next block and it changes.
rules: A swap clears only when its amount matches the current block number's last digits.
Miss and the swap reverts - the target moves each block.
Retry on the next block for a fresh number.
